final.summary: News report in scope: Streetsblog NYC Oct. 29, 2026 — DSNY truck driver kills pedestrian Siobhan Lynch, 30, at Cropsey Ave and Bay Parkway, Brooklyn. Crash history shows a high-injury turning-crash pattern on a wide, refuge-less crossing on a Vision Zero Priority Corridor already programmed for bus and safety work. DRAFT REQUEST LETTER: To NYC DOT Commissioner — We request immediate safety action at Bay Parkway and Cropsey Ave (Bath Beach, Brooklyn) following the Oct. 28 fatal right-turn truck strike of pedestrian Siobhan Lynch. City data show ~30 KSI 2021-2025 on the corridor and high injuries at this intersection, with left turns causing 40% of pedestrian injuries. We ask DOT to add the excluded pedestrian median island/refuge, curb extensions, hardened turn calming, leading pedestrian interval, and left-turn lane or restriction review at this intersection, consistent with the Bay Parkway/Cropsey bus and safety project, and report back on timing.
